newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy mini-budget to be 14-15 trln lire-Pennacchi.
newsitem.headline: Italy mini-budget to be 14-15 trln lire-Pennacchi.

text.p: Italian Treasury undersecretary Laura Pennacchi said on Wednesday that a 1997 mini-budget being drawn up would be for between 14 and 15 trillion lire.
Pennachi was clarifying remarks made on Tuesday.
Prime minister Romano Prodi said last week the government was working on a mini-budget in a push to get state accounts ready for the single European currency.
Economists have expected about 15 trillion lire of new deficit-cutting measures.
